Commentary: Ali Usman to Ollie Robinson, THATS OUT!! Bowled!!

Ali Usman to Ollie Robinson, out Bowled!! Rippaaaaaahhhhh! Fifer for Ali Usman. He is on a roll now. Showing his full repertoire. That was a tossed up delivery, turned a smidgen and beat the sticks to knock the pole back. That was a superb delivery and Ollie Robinson had no answers to it. First ball for him and he tried to cover the line but the ball was just too good. Pakistan need two more to wrap it up. Ali Usman is on a hat-trick. Maiden fifer as well!
